regions.name: Ocean (W strip)
regions.problem: v1 fixed the straightness but introduced a continuous straight MUD WALL - traded one artifact for another; gradient ran after fractalize and re-straightened it
regions.intent: depth ramp ONLY (deep->shallow->sand), then fractalize the coast LAST, then scatter mud as wet-beach patches not a band

regions.name: Central sand flat
regions.problem: v1 wash + hill good; vegetation too faint to read
regions.intent: keep wash+hill, raise vegetation density and give it a couple of soil clumps

regions.name: Rock massif
regions.problem: v1 cave + talus foot worked well

regions.name: Gravel outcrops
regions.intent: keep; smooth again at the end to absorb new confetti from the coast edits

edits.rationale: Repaint just the water column x0-16 W->E as deep->shallow->shallow->sand. No mud in the order, so no brown wall. This sets a clean depth ramp that we will then roughen.
A brackish beach is patchy, not a stripe. Scatter Mud only onto sand cells in the narrow shore band x10-20, low density and clumped, so wet spots cluster near the waterline.

edits.what: Old dry wash across the flat
edits.rationale: Same gravel wash SW->NE; a line of movement and a soft chokepoint through the dead center.
Raise mossy scatter density and cluster it so vegetation actually reads on the flat.

edits.what: Small fertile hollow by the wash
edits.rationale: One soil clump near the wash bend (~44,62) - a plausible catchment where runoff pools, and the map's only decent farm spot (scarcity anchor).
Low hill at ~(38,52) for high-ground cover in the dead zone.
Carve into the solid RockFace core (~95,92); carve_chamber only eats solid rock so it stays enclosed.
Rubble apron at ~(66,44) to soften the abrupt rock/sand foot and add light cover.
Ancient-concrete footprint at ~(28,61): a landmark ruin + defensible strongpoint.
Run fractalize AFTER the gradient this time so nothing re-straightens it. Push shallow water in/out irregularly against sand for a meandering shore.
Majority-smooth non-water families to absorb single-cell specks created by the coast + scatter edits.

notes: Cave chamber: seed ancient danger / infestation deep inside - not free real estate.
Ruined structure: slain ancients + salvage; crashed-Factory-ship scavenger theme.
Fertile hollow by the wash: the natural farm start - raids will approach along the open wash.
Wet-beach mud: brackish/non-potable - reinforces water-scarcity pillar (desalinate to drink).
